forum.title: Need 'Suggestion' Label in tools forums
forum.best_answer_content:
Thanks for suggestion @Andrew Neil. The team agrees with your request.

You can now find the label **Feature request**in:

[STM32CubeIDE (MCUs) - STMicroelectronics Community](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32cubeide-mcus/bd-p/stm32-mcu-cubeide-forum)

[STM32CubeMX (MCUs) - STMicroelectronics Community](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32cubemx-mcus/bd-p/stm32-mcu-cubemx-forum)

[STM32CubeMX2 (MCUs) - STMicroelectronics Community](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32cubemx2-mcus/bd-p/stm32cubemx2-mcus)

[STM32CubeProgrammer (MCUs) - STMicroelectronics Community](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32cubeprogrammer-mcus/bd-p/stm32-mcu-cubeprogrammer-forum)

Feel free to adjust labels in the posts where you see fit.

Regards,

Lina
forum.content_text:
Or 'Feature Request' or similar.

Applies to CubeIDE, CubeMX, and CubeMX2 - probably also others ...

eg, see [here](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32cubemx-mcus/inconsistent-pin-naming/m-p/887139#M35510:~:text=There%20isn%27t%20a%20label%20for%20%22suggestion%22%20%2D%20so%20%22bug%20report%22%20is%20the%20nearest%20option) and [here](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32cubemx2-mcus/inconsistent-generated-pin-and-port-names/td-p/887166#:~:text=again%2C%20no%20label%20available%20for%20%22Suggestions%22).
